title: ServiceNow Developer
summary: ServiceNow developers configure and script the ServiceNow platform, which companies use to run IT help desks, requests and other workflows. They usually work in IT services firms or internal IT teams, alongside process owners, admins and testers.
dailyDuties: Write business rules, client scripts and script includes
Build catalog items and approval flows in Flow Designer
Configure incident, change and request processes
Build a REST integration with another tool
Fix defects raised by users and testers

skills.expectation: Write business rules, client scripts, script includes and UI policies with the Glide API
Write clean server-side and client-side JavaScript
Configure incident, problem, change and request processes the ITIL way
Automate approvals and tasks with Flow Designer and IntegrationHub
Build REST or SOAP integrations with other tools
Gather requirements from process owners and demo changes to them
Work with the CMDB, Discovery and MID Servers
Build Service Portal pages and widgets
Set up LDAP or SSO sign-in and roles for users

certifications.why: Developer postings usually expect CSA as the base certification.
The developer-level ServiceNow certification, often paired with CSA in postings.
